issue_context.title: Update `ui_test` to 0.23.0
issue_context.body:
[`ui_test`](https://github.com/oli-obk/ui_test) has updated to 0.23.0, fixing https://github.com/oli-obk/ui_test/issues/211. This means that the version number can be removed for the dependency on all compile fail tests.

https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/blob/77ebabc4fe0224565a2039bd9c0195901560b67f/crates/bevy_ecs/compile_fail/Cargo.toml#L10-L12

This is a non-trivial update with breaking changes, so it will require a bit more effort than changing a version number.

cc @Brezak

review_comments: (Non-blocking) Could you add a comment explaining what this line is doing? It's a bit confusing.
